staticFrame.alt: A layered mechanical watch in a dark case. A pale order record runs through its gear train, and a red latch holds a completion proposal outside the record.

scenes.label: 01 / The night watch
scenes.heading:
The Night
Watch.
scenes.lead:
The model can sleep.
The order stays open.
scenes.narration: A journey into the mechanism that decides when an order is finished.

scenes.label: 02 / Beneath the face
scenes.heading:
Open the
watch.
scenes.narration: The outer face lifts away. Inside, the lifecycle holds the order while individual reasoning cycles come and go.
scenes.note: The watch is a metaphor for the source behavior.

scenes.label: 03 / The continuous record
scenes.heading:
Something
has to stay.
scenes.lead: The record runs through the machinery.
scenes.narration: A workflow instance supervises one order. It starts with an agent cycle, then waits for events or a scheduled timeout.
scenes.note: The record marks are illustrative, not a customer order.

scenes.label: 04 / A cycle of attention
scenes.heading:
The machinery
wakes.
scenes.narration: The next cycle receives the order context and pending events. The agent proposes what should happen next.
scenes.note: Business actions write activity-log entries. No external messages are sent.

scenes.label: 05 / Between cycles
scenes.heading:
Still on
watch.
scenes.lead: The reasoning stops. Supervision does not.
scenes.narration: When the cycle finishes, the workflow waits again. It does not need the model to think continuously to remain responsible for the order.
scenes.note: Stillness is part of the lifecycle.

scenes.label: 06 / The authority boundary
scenes.heading:
A proposal.
A hard stop.
scenes.lead: “Complete” reaches the latch. It cannot pass.
scenes.narration: The model’s recommendation cannot finish the workflow by itself. The lifecycle condition owns that decision.
scenes.note: The agent advises. The workflow decides.

scenes.label: 07 / The release
scenes.heading:
An event turns
the key.
scenes.lead: The completion path has its own rules.
scenes.narration: Delivered, refund resolved or order cancelled: a terminal event is followed by the agent cycle, then completion. Manual termination and maximum age are separate paths.
scenes.note: This is not a universal human-approval gate.

scenes.label: 08 / The final record
scenes.heading:
Closed.
On record.
scenes.narration: The workflow saves why the order ended and calls for its final summary. The model contributes reasoning; the lifecycle owns the close.
scenes.note: Illustrated from source behavior, not a live order.

audio.explanation: This world is a silent mechanical illustration. It has no audio asset and makes no audio request.
